title: The Knight You Must Not Take
setup: White met your knight with a passive knight to d2, took the e5 pawn, and has just kicked your knight with h3.
hint: Your knight is attacked. Look for the square where capturing it would tear the roof off White's own king.
explanation:
## The Idea

With the knight on d2 shutting in the bishop on c1, White's king has little cover on the dark squares.

{{Ne3}} attacks the queen on d1 from a square White would love to take. Taking is the blunder: after {{fxe3}}, {{Qh4+}} leaves only {{g3}}, and {{Qxg3#}} covers f2 while White's own pieces fill the rest. White's best is to give up the queen instead.

Before you take a piece that walked in on purpose, ask what the capture opens.
